verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking SaaS, and a natural-language command interface (such as an AI assistant for transfers or bill pay) is a fair capability to ask of this kind of product, so the axis applies. Every documented workflow is operated through app screens and menus (Accounts → Limits, Cards, Invoices) or rule-based automations. The llms.txt probe only makes support docs readable by LLMs; it does not let users command the product in natural language, so nothing in the pack evidences this capability.
